plan.message:
Decode payload first. Split on ASCII spaces, retaining empty fields. Partition into consecutive groups of 512 fields; only the last may be shorter. Within each group, order distinct fields by increasing occurrence count, breaking ties by ASCII text order. Use this field order in all lexicographic comparisons. For each group L, stably sort its indices by that field order; LF maps each old index to its sorted position. For each LF cycle collect L values, reverse them, and take the lexicographically least cyclic rotation. Sort these cycles in descending lexicographic order and concatenate. Join all fields with ASCII spaces; print only.
